entities.summary: Austin Czarnik is an American professional ice hockey center who is currently playing for Lausanne HC of the National League (NL). Undrafted, Czarnik has played in the National Hockey League (NHL) with the Boston Bruins, Calgary Flames, New York Islanders, Seattle Kraken and Detroit Red Wings.
